trials.claim: Lifetime access to the platform on 1-Code tier
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Easy Text Marketing Platform
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: One buyer reports receiving no access after purchase, which directly conflicts with the promised access, despite another buyer reporting use for over a year.

exhibits.quote: I purchased the product yesterday! No access untill now!!!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports receiving no access after purchase, undermining lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We purchased the Easy Text Marketing Agency Platform to send messages for a client, but unfortunately, it has been nothing but trouble.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the platform was nothing but trouble for client messaging, undermining usable lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I have been using Easy Text Marketing for over a year now, and it has been a solid option for integrating SMS into my offerings.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms continuous long-term access to the platform over a year, consistent with lifetime access.

trials.claim: Unlimited messaging, voice broadcasts and groups with gateway connected
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited messaging (with your gateway connected)
- Unlimited voice broadcasts (with your gateway connected)
- Unlimited groups
trials.reasoning: Buyers report they could not use any gateway, could not send messages, and that the gateway was missing, directly conflicting with unlimited messaging with a gateway connected.

exhibits.quote: I couldn't use any gateway, I couldn't send any messages, I couldn't even upload a single contact.
exhibits.argument: Buyer could not use any gateway or send messages, contradicting unlimited messaging with gateway connected.

exhibits.quote: I hate to leave bad reviews but this product doesn't work as advertised the gateway is missing the agency section is missing as well.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the gateway is missing and product does not work as advertised.

exhibits.quote: If you need a cheap way to send a lot of SMS messages, this is hands down your best option!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the platform works for sending a high volume of SMS messages cheaply.

trials.claim: Unlimited keywords, digital coupons, mobile kiosks & contests, web forms & polls
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited keywords
- Unlimited digital coupons
- Unlimited mobile kiosks & contests
- Unlimited web forms & polls
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit shows one keyword working, which does not establish unlimited keywords or the promised coupons, kiosks, contests, web forms, and polls.

exhibits.quote: I use the MLS number as the keyword, and it works perfectly!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the keywords feature works perfectly in real use.

exhibits.quote: wanted to use it to send from a different gateway but there was no way to do that either.
exhibits.argument: Buyer could not send from a different gateway, undermining works-with-any-gateway claim.
